subject: BASED clause
notes: (kb/Work PB1214, 14d). cite.py --check 13.18.5.4 'The implicit data-address pointer has an initial value of NULL.' OK §13.18.5.4 2); the rule defers the life cycle to §8.6.5 (--check 8.6.5 'when the based entry is defined in the working-storage or local-storage section, at the end of the life cycle of the data items defined in that section' OK) and §8.6.4 makes LOCAL-STORAGE items automatic, 'allocated and set to initial state each time the runtime element containing them is activated'. FIRST HALF CONFORMS: the field is emitted `= ManagedPointer.Null`; WS static persists across CALLs and CANCEL resets it; INITIAL program WS resets each call (probe gr2.cob: WS NULL / WS NOT NULL / after CANCEL WS NULL; INIT NULL twice). LIFE-CYCLE HALF DIVERGES for a PROGRAM's LOCAL-STORAGE based entry: probe E:/Temp/claude/E--COBOL/a700c052-f9e4-4942-84ff-a13c7505d6ec/scratchpad/adj-d1/out13/probe/based/gr2b.cob (LS `01 B PIC X(4) BASED.`, SET ADDRESS OF B TO ADDRESS OF W, GOBACK, CALL again) prints 'LS NULL' then 'LS NOT NULL B=WWWW' (also at --std 2014, gr2e.cob) while the ordinary LS item X re-initialises (X=1 both times). Expected from spec: second activation 'LS NULL'. Mechanism: ProgramEmitter's cached-singleton LS re-init loop `continue`s on every StringCanonical cell-backed root, so the implicit pointer field is never re-seeded; OO methods have PtrActivationSeed, programs have no counterpart (two-arm dispatch). Sibling outside this row: an ADDRESS-OF-taken LS record is not re-initialised either (sib.cob: A=INIT then A=CHGD). Observation not adjudicated as a defect: a LINKAGE based entry keeps its association into the next CALL (gr2c.cob: LK NULL / LK NOT NULL) although §8.6.5 ends the association 'at the end of the execution of the runtime element' - the spec does not state the pointer's value afterwards.
